_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 slows the pm rush (3:42 to 5:25 per eighth) and cuts midnight to 5 am to 3.3 s without a faster peak rate
_why.CARD_LINES: line 2 is two short lines that read at a glance; the trains video after it opens on line 1
_why.OUTSIDE_DIM: 0.75 drops Mississauga and York Region to a faint hint, so Toronto reads 4.2x brighter than its neighbours (b: 2.9x)
